datasets.name: Palmer Penguins
datasets.description: Body measurements of three penguin species observed on three islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. Includes text columns and a few missing values, which makes it a good first classification dataset.
datasets.source: Gorman, Williams & Fraser (2014), Palmer Station LTER. Distributed in the palmerpenguins package, CC0.

datasets.name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
datasets.description: Thirty measurements computed from digitised images of breast-mass cell nuclei, labelled malignant or benign. All features are numeric and there are no missing values.
datasets.source: Wolberg, Street & Mangasarian, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0.

datasets.name: Wine Recognition
datasets.description: Chemical analysis of 178 wines grown in the same region of Italy by three different cultivars. A small, clean multiclass problem.
datasets.source: Forina et al., UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0.

datasets.name: Diabetes Progression
datasets.description: Age, sex, BMI, blood pressure and six blood serum measurements for 442 diabetes patients. The target is a quantitative measure of disease progression one year later.
datasets.source: Efron, Hastie, Johnstone & Tibshirani (2004), Least Angle Regression. Distributed with scikit-learn.

datasets.name: Auto MPG
datasets.description: Fuel economy, engine size, weight and origin of cars from 1970 to 1982. Horsepower has missing values, and the car name column is free text that should not be used as a feature.
datasets.source: Quinlan (1993), StatLib, via UCI Machine Learning Repository (CC BY 4.0) and vega-datasets. Rows with no MPG value removed.

datasets.name: Seattle Weather
datasets.description: Daily precipitation, temperature range and wind in Seattle from 2012 to 2015, with the day's weather type. The classes are imbalanced: snow and drizzle are rare.
datasets.source: NOAA daily climate records, via vega-datasets.

datasets.name: Iris
datasets.description: Sepal and petal measurements of 150 iris flowers from three species. The classic first dataset in machine learning.
datasets.source: Fisher (1936), UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0.
